disagreements: Decision 3's literal eps_now = max over cells of sup_distance(emitted hull, exact cell box) is the box diagonal (about sqrt(2) * cell width on a circle), which is always larger than the certified gap to the nearest non-adjacent cell (about cell width), so the packet's own test 1 (R=2 circle -> Ok) is unsatisfiable with the literal formula AND the literal (iv-b)(c) gate box_distance(H_j, E_k) > eps_now: the loop would refine forever. The packet's d=0..3 witnesses are the TRUE radial error from dense sampling, not the box diagonal. My module reproduces the true error through its own HermiteCurve formulas: 0.337127 / 0.429204 / 0.030426 / 0.001962 (the packet's d=0 value 0.336512 differs by 0.2%; d=1, d=2, d=3 and the d=2 min|cos| = 0.999614 match exactly), so I measure eps per sub-cell and gate separation per cell, which makes the circle and the family emit.

A plain 'two segments meeting at 60 degrees' V does not make the landed curvature_radius_lower_span / self_separation_lower_span refuse: with travel directions (1,0) and (cos60, sin60) the corner cell's tangent box hull has immersion lower bound > 0 (it does not straddle the origin), the legs are straight so curvature is +inf, and a corner at a dyadic bisection boundary makes every cell straight at every depth so the helpers return +inf instead of refusing.
